nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires whenever a workflow that has this one set as its 'Error workflow' fails.

nodes.name: Telegram: Alert Ops
nodes.notes: Set chatId to your ops / alerts channel. It can be the same bot as the sales bot.

parameters.content:
## Error handler
Open **Lead Onboarding** and **Daily Digest** → *Settings* → *Error workflow* → pick this workflow.

Every failed execution then posts the workflow name, failing node, error message and a deep link to the execution in Telegram (and optionally Slack).

⚠️ **Activate this workflow** (toggle top-right). Since n8n 2.x an inactive error workflow is skipped with the log line *"is not active and cannot be executed"*.
